sources.entry: Linear Mouse - Full control of mouse. Change the speed, scrolling direction, pointer type and much more. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/linearmouse/linearmouse)

summary.name: LinearMouse
summary.one_liner: LinearMouse is a macOS utility for customizing mouse and trackpad behavior, including scrolling direction, pointer acceleration and speed, and button remapping.
use_cases: Reverse mouse scrolling while keeping natural trackpad scrolling
Turn off pointer acceleration for precise aiming or drawing
Remap mouse buttons to shortcuts or Mission Control
Set different mouse profiles for different apps or displays
summary.what_it_does: The page describes LinearMouse as a tool for tuning mouse and trackpad settings. It supports separate scrolling directions for trackpad and mouse, with each direction adjustable. Users can fine-tune pointer acceleration and speed, reset to system defaults, or disable acceleration entirely. Buttons and scroll actions can be remapped to shortcuts, media controls, Mission Control, and gesture-driven workflows. Settings can be profiled by device, app, or display.
notable: Separate scrolling direction settings for mouse and trackpad
Profiles that vary by device, app, or display
Can turn off pointer acceleration completely
Open source (listed on awesome-mac with an open-source icon linking to GitHub)
caveats: Platform support beyond macOS is not stated on the page
Pricing is not stated on the page
